restrictions: Two distinct 128-byte one-block messages m(a), m(b) of sha3-256-r14-prefix-v1 (zero state, rate 136, suffix 0x06 with pad10*1, rounds 0 to 13, full 256-bit digest). m(u) places the point u (lanes u0..u3) in lanes 1, 6, 11 = u0, u1, u0^u1^K11 and 4, 9, 14 = u2, u3, u2^u3^K14, the other lanes 0..15 fixed constants K of trial 3600 (proof.md Section 2); F(u) = SHA3-256-r14(m(u)) xor PD, and F(a) = F(b) with a != b is a collision of two distinct messages.

Distinguished-point parallel collision search (van Oorschot-Wiener) on F with 256 walks per step, the search of 71fefe66 unchanged: DP = image x < 529 x 2^135 (theta = 529 x 2^-121), no trail cut, replay cap 52767223885100277066701767626981376 steps (10.5000 / theta), at most 73536 trails, a table of 18384 words with four 64-bit records each (46 end bits and the trail number), Tb = 1327484005664611257738613572459560960 steps, a prefilter-hit counter that aborts at hit HMAX + 1, and one replay that measures the stored trail by walking it to its DP (proof.md Section 4).

One step of 256 walks executes 80661 register operations (58389 XOR, 11269 AND, 8187 OR, 2752 NOT, 64 calls, returns and iota XORs; no loads or stores): the prefix P (rounds 0 and 1, linear-structure affine forms), the generic rounds 2..12 as a cycle of 6 shared bodies on two register banks (body (r - 2) mod 6 + 1 for round r, called with JAL/JR, iota by XOR of the all-ones register), the last body forced to the bank-X polarity by target rows, and the last round E; lazy theta, 10-gate chi rows and the annealed polarity plan of 71fefe66 per block (generator gen4.c, proof.md Section 3).

Cost model collision-frontier-v5, unit 3794: N = Tb x 80681 + replay + R + PRE = 107716392458046194420068321957714726103970 word operations, every operation of the assembled other code counted (2716 instructions, proof.md Section 4.3 and Appendix D), PRE = a clock bound on every generator run: the charged run gen4 4096 0 3, the inspection run, the cycle-length selection runs and the build steps (preprocessing_log2 48); time_log2 = 124.41679 by the integer certificate of Appendix A.

Machine model (declared prices of the cost model of this entry, proof.md Section 3.6; the benchmark fixes neither): a declared file of 3536 registers of 256 bits counted as 113152 bytes of memory, an operation on registers one word operation, every load and store of the other code charged; 5 bytes per straight-line instruction (stored once per block), 32 bytes per instruction of the other code, the calls and returns of the step included; PERM one unit. The conventions of 71fefe66 (from 67f781f8) with a larger register file.

Memory at most 1043392 bytes <= 2^20 (search phase: registers, step code, other code, table, walk state, data image; proof.md Section 6); the generator run precedes the search and is charged with its image, a 16,384-byte stack and the block files it writes.

Success at least 0.39 for one attempt over the fresh word rho, under the score-critical premise H_rand of 71fefe66 (over the algorithm's coin rho the program on the fixed target succeeds with at least the random-function probability of proof.md Section 5), with failure terms F6 (a colliding trail longer than LRC), F2, F3, F4 and the hit-counter abort F5 < 2^-1000 (proved).

heuristics.statement: Premise H_rand (the premise of 71fefe66, our use): over the algorithm's coins, the program run on the fixed SHA3-256-r14 target (F(u) = SHA3-256-r14(m(u)) xor PD, with the linear-structure message embedding m of proof.md Section 2) succeeds with probability at least the probability computed in proof.md Section 5 for a uniformly random function F from 256-bit values to 256-bit values. The only coin is the uniform word rho; given rho the run is deterministic. In the random-function model one attempt succeeds with probability at least 0.39 after the failure terms.
heuristics.scope: The fixed function F of proof.md Section 2 on the points of one attempt: about 0.998688 x 2^128 evaluations in 256 lockstep walks from starts rho + i, i < 73536. Only the pair-coincidence rate among evaluated images and the distinguished-point rate enter the bound. The step program, the cost, the memory and the failure terms are derived, not assumed.
heuristics.extrapolation: Not an estimate of the success probability for the fixed target. Organizer-executed program checks: rho-w22 runs the whole search with the claimed step at width 22; proj-w256 runs eight chained full-width steps and tests 22-bit agreement (model 0.3934 per trial). Our own runs on the block files of this package (proof.md Section 7.2): pair-coincidence rates on three 32-bit windows among 2^24 images of uniform inputs, of consecutive starts and of chained iterates, and single-bit difference statistics.
heuristics.limitations: Our theory; no proof. No run reaches 2^128 and no full collision is claimed. The checks work at 22 and 32 bits. A pair-coincidence deficit eps costs about 0.5 log2(1/(1 - eps)) bits of time.
